name: Coconut vinegar
description: Cloudy vinegar from fermented coconut sap — the Filipino souring agent.

tcm.note: Cu is warm, sour and astringent.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.

effects.note: Acetic acid taken with a meal measurably blunts the blood glucose spike that follows — a meta-analysis of eleven trials found a real, if inconsistent, reduction in post-meal glucose and insulin response, with notable heterogeneity between studies. A splash as a souring agent is close to trial doses. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
